articles.title: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow
articles.summary: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow
articles.summaryTr: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.
articles.articleText: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow - Published US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff held a fresh round of talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow, a day after the latest discussions aimed at ending the war in Ukraine wrapped up in Abu Dhabi. The pair are now flying to Dublin to meet Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky, and Witkoff said a new round of trilateral talks had already been agreed with Putin. Earlier on Thursday Zelensky said Ukraine's military was again facing "systematic" restrictions to Starlink's military-grade satellite service, Starshield, meaning Kyiv was struggling to intercept Russian jet-powered drones. The talks in the Emirates were framed as being centred around European security arrangements in a post-war scenario, although a resolution to the war sparked by Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 still appears distant. Comments by both President Vladimir Putin and Kremlin officials suggest that Russia's position on the war has not shifted, and that Moscow's demands for territory and neutrality continue to far exceed what Ukraine is prepared to consider. Witkoff said that Europeans would join the next round of talks. "They are our partners and it's important to us that they take part," Witkoff told Russian state TV after meeting Putin in the Kremlin. Zelensky said Ukraine was trying to clear up the Starlink situation with the American side but added "some things" were already clear: "If someone in America is making decisions that basically treat Ukrainian territory as if it is not Ukrainian, then this tells us where things are going." He did not elaborate further. Starshield was developed by Elon Musk's SpaceX company for government and military use. Along with Starlink, it has come to play a vital role in facilitating communication on Ukraine's front line. A similar issue with connectivity affected the front line in late October and lasted about a week before it was fixed and it remained unclear who had ordered the temporary restrictions. - Why is Ukraine so reliant on Starlink and can Europe plug the gap? - Published25 October Zelensky said the current disruption had been ongoing for several days and was "helping the Russians kill more Ukrainians and carry out more accurate strikes against Ukraine". Meanwhile, some of the longstanding roadblocks in the peace process were addressed during the US-Russia talks in the Kremlin. The territorial issue continues to be a key point of contention, Putin said. "For us there is only one line of demarcation: the line of the state border. Because then it will be clear that we are here, and you are there. As soon as we start discussing 'grey zones'… arguments immediately start and any agreements become unstable. And there will be no lasting peace." He also suggested organising a humanitarian truce to allow for the evacuation of hundreds of civilians from a frontline area, on the model of last month's ceasefire in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky. Putin suggested a similar five-day ceasefire for Kostyantynivka, a contested front-line Ukrainian city in the eastern region of Donetsk. Kyiv disputes that Russia fully holds the town, and a truce could help Moscow's troops to make a final push to seize it. "Considering that they brought in equipment and rotated troops in Oleshky under the guise of a humanitarian operation, it's clear what they want in Kostyantynivka," Ukrainian presidential adviser Dmitry Lytvyn told the BBC, adding that the details would need to be "clarified". But at the core of this week's talks has been the issue of European security architecture. Earlier Kushner said the US hoped to "create a new framework" of security between Ukraine, Russia and Europe that could "secure lasting peace", while Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov said it was "clear that the current system does not work." Ukraine and Europe have long been concerned about the current US administration's commitment to European security and its softening towards the Kremlin and that decisions about their continent could be made without them. Zelensky said he found the US approach of discussing a new European security order with Russia "a bit strange". "It is a significant shift in the US position that the US has now taken on board the Russian demand that the European security architecture needs to be discussed and agreed upon in parallel with the Ukraine peace talks," said the Director of the Estonian Foreign Policy Institute Kristi Raik. She said the Russians have a "long history" of wanting to revise European security architecture, intended as core principles "like sovereignty, territorial integrity, the principle that there is no use of force to some conflicts". Russia "has long looked to reduced Nato presence on the Eastern flank and that… get some kind of veto rights in decisions concerning European security and defence," Raik said. "And that's where it gets even more difficult to imagine that there could be an agreement between the Europeans and the Russians." On Thursday, Putin again repeated that the presence of foreign troops in Ukraine was "unacceptable" to Russia, and said Russia would like the Americans to engage with Europe "so that the Europeans can decide what they truly want: peace or war". During the first years of the war, Europeans cut communications with the Kremlin and refused to engage with Russia directly. That position has now shifted for many as concern that decisions about the European continent could be made without European involvement. Kushner also urged Europe to "identify one person to speak on their behalf" in the negotiations. But the Kremlin has not confirmed the make-up of next week's talks, and at the start of the meeting, Putin had indicated he didn't want European countries to play a full role. The Russians have long cited Europe's support for Kyiv as an obstacle to their involvement. Speaking to Kushner and Witkoff, Putin said he was encouraging them "to work with your European allies so that they finally decide whether they want peace or war in Ukraine." Related topics - Published15 October

articles.title: Trump'tan Nvidia'nın yeni CEO'su için sürpriz öneri: Apple'dan o ismi işaret etti
articles.summary: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Jensen Huang'ın istifasının ardından Nvidia CEO'luğu için Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'u önerdi. Trump, "Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor" ifadelerini kullandı.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Trump'tan Nvidia'nın yeni CEO'su için sürpriz öneri: Apple'dan o ismi işaret etti
articles.summaryTr: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Jensen Huang'ın istifasının ardından Nvidia CEO'luğu için Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'u önerdi. Trump, "Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor" ifadelerini kullandı.
articles.articleText: Trump'tan Nvidia'nın yeni CEO'su için sürpriz öneri: Apple'dan o ismi işaret etti - ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Jensen Huang'ın istifasının ardından Nvidia CEO'luğu için Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'u önerdi. - Trump, "Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor." ifadelerini kullandı. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang'ın görevinden ayrılmasının ardından şirketin yeni CEO'su için dikkat çeken bir isim önerdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Trump, Truth Social hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda, Huang'ın görev süresince "harika" işler yaptığını belirterek, yerine Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'un geçmesi gerektiğini savundu. Trump, "Jensen Huang istifa ettiğine göre, onun yerini alabilecek tek bir kişi var, Apple'dan Tim Cook. Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor." değerlendirmesinde bulundu. Nvidia'da geçici CEO Colette Kress oldu Nvidia, Jensen Huang'ın başkanlık, üst yöneticilik ve yönetim kurulu üyeliği görevlerinden derhal geçerli olmak üzere ayrıldığını açıklamıştı. Şirketin başkan yardımcısı ve Finans Direktörü (CFO) Colette Kress'in geçici CEO olarak görev yapmayı kabul ettiği bildirilmişti. Huang'ın istifası, hakkında evlilik dışı iki ilişki yaşadığına ilişkin haberlerin ardından geldi. Söz konusu haberlerde, kadınlardan birinin Çin adına istihbarat topladığı da iddia edilmişti.

articles.summary: Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy, Rusya-Ukrayna savaşının sona erdirilmesine yönelik müzakerelerde Avrupa'nın daimi olarak yer alması gerektiğini söyledi. Zelenskiy, hava savunması ve enerji desteği için Avrupalı liderlere çağrıda bulundu.

articles.titleTr: Zelenskiy Avrupa'yı devreye sokmak istiyor: Rusya ile görüşmelerde yeni talep
articles.summaryTr: Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy, Rusya-Ukrayna savaşının sona erdirilmesine yönelik müzakerelerde Avrupa'nın daimi olarak yer alması gerektiğini söyledi. Zelenskiy, hava savunması ve enerji desteği için Avrupalı liderlere çağrıda bulundu.
articles.articleText: Zelenskiy Avrupa'yı devreye sokmak istiyor: Rusya ile görüşmelerde yeni talep - Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy, Rusya-Ukrayna savaşının sona erdirilmesine yönelik müzakerelerde Avrupa'nın daimi olarak yer alması gerektiğini söyledi. - Zelenskiy, hava savunması ve enerji desteği için Avrupalı liderlere çağrıda bulundu. Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy, Avrupa'nın Rusya-Ukrayna savaşını sona erdirmeye yönelik müzakerelerde kalıcı şekilde yer alması gerektiğini belirtti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İrlanda'nın başkenti Dublin'de düzenlenen Avrupa Siyasi Topluluğu (AST) 9. Zirvesi'nin açılışında konuşan Zelenskiy, Rusya'da bulunan ABD heyetinin akşam saatlerinde Dublin'e geleceğini ve görüşmelerin sonuçlarını burada ele alacaklarını bildirdi. Avrupa'nın Rusya'nın da bulunduğu müzakere masasında doğrudan yer almasa da sürece dolaylı biçimde dahil olmasını olumlu değerlendiren Zelenskiy, "Avrupa'nın müzakerelerin daimi unsuru olmasını sağlamalıyız." dedi. Abu Dabi görüşmelerinde esir takası gündemdeydi Birleşik Arap Emirlikleri'nin (BAE) başkenti Abu Dabi'de gerçekleştirilen görüşmelerin ciddi geçtiğini belirten Zelenskiy, esir takası konusunda sağlanan mutabakatın önemine dikkati çekti. Güvenlik garantilerine ilişkin görüşmelerde Avrupa ile Rusya arasında yeni bir güvenlik mimarisi oluşturulması ihtimalinin de gündeme geldiğini aktaran Zelenskiy, bu yaklaşımı "tuhaf" bulduklarını ifade etti. Ukrayna heyetinin Karadeniz'de gerilimi azaltacak ve enerji altyapısına yönelik saldırıları durduracak adımlar önerdiğini belirten Zelenskiy, Rus heyetinin bu konuları görüşme yetkisi bulunmadığını söylediğini aktardı. Zelenskiy'den Patriot, NASAMS ve F-16 mühimmatı talebi Ukrayna'nın öncelikleri arasında hava savunma sistemleri için mühimmat tedariki ve enerji ihtiyacının karşılanmasının bulunduğunu belirten Zelenskiy, Patriot ve NASAMS sistemleri ile F-16 savaş uçakları için mühimmat desteğine ihtiyaç duyduklarını söyledi. Zelenskiy, bu başlıklarda Avrupalı liderlerden destek istedi.

Ukrayna heyetinin Karadeniz'de gerilimi azaltacak ve enerji altyapısına yönelik saldırıları durduracak adımlar önerdiğini belirten Zelenskiy, Rus heyetinin bu konuları görüşme yetkisi bulunmadığını söylediğini aktardı. Zelenskiy'den Patriot, NASAMS ve F-16 mühimmatı talebi Ukrayna'nın öncelikleri arasında hava savunma sistemleri için mühimmat tedariki ve enerji ihtiyacının karşılanmasının bulunduğunu belirten Zelenskiy, Patriot ve NASAMS sistemleri ile F-16 savaş uçakları için mühimmat desteğine ihtiyaç duyduklarını söyledi. Zelenskiy, bu başlıklarda Avrupalı liderlerden destek istedi.

articles.summaryTr: İran Cumhurbaşkanı Mesud Pezeşkiyan, ABD'nin baskılarla İran halkını diz çöktürmeye çalıştığını belirterek, "Kendisi yavaş yavaş diz çöküyor" dedi. Pezeşkiyan, Antalya'daki COP31 kapsamında gerçekleştirdiği görüşmelerin olumlu geçtiğini söyledi.
articles.articleText: Antalya'daki zirvede dikkat çeken çıkış: Pezeşkiyan'dan ABD'ye diz çökme mesajı - İran Cumhurbaşkanı Mesud Pezeşkiyan, ABD'nin baskılarla İran halkını diz çöktürmeye çalıştığını belirterek, "Kendisi yavaş yavaş diz çöküyor." dedi. - Pezeşkiyan, Antalya'daki COP31 kapsamında gerçekleştirdiği görüşmelerin olumlu geçtiğini söyledi. İran Cumhurbaşkanı Mesud Pezeşkiyan, Antalya'da düzenlenen Birleşmiş Milletler (BM) İklim Değişikliği Çerçeve Sözleşmesi 31. Taraflar Konferansı (COP31) Liderler Zirvesi kapsamında yaptığı temasları değerlendirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İran devlet televizyonuna konuşan Pezeşkiyan, zirvede İran'ın görüşlerini ifade etme fırsatı bulduklarını belirterek, çeşitli ülkelerin cumhurbaşkanları ve dışişleri bakanlarıyla gerçekleştirdiği görüşmelerin olumlu geçtiğini kaydetti. Görüşmelerde işbirliği imkanlarının ele alındığını ve diyalogun gelecekte de sürmesini umduğunu ifade eden Pezeşkiyan, ABD'nin İran'a yönelik baskılarına ilişkin dikkat çeken açıklamalarda bulundu. Pezeşkiyan, ABD'nin uyguladığı baskılarla İran halkını diz çöktürmeye çalıştığını ancak kendisinin yavaş yavaş diz çöktüğünü savundu. "İran halkının geleceği için çalışmalıyız" İran halkının ekonomik ve sosyal koşullarının iyileştirilmesinin öncelikleri olduğunu belirten Pezeşkiyan, "Bizim için önemli olan, İran halkının geçim sorunu, hayatı ve geleceğiyle ilgili olarak neler yapmamız gerektiğidir. İnsanların umutlu olmasını istiyoruz." ifadelerini kullandı. Erdoğan ile de görüştü Pezeşkiyan, Antalya'daki zirvede yaptığı konuşmanın yanı sıra Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ile ikili görüşme gerçekleştirdi. İran Cumhurbaşkanı ayrıca Irak ve Brezilya cumhurbaşkanları, Pakistan, Ermenistan ve Norveç başbakanları ile Irak Kürt Bölgesel Yönetimi Başkanı'yla da bir araya geldi.

articles.summary: IMF Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında gerilemesini beklediklerini açıkladı. Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin de enflasyon üzerinde etkili olabileceğini belirtti.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Enflasyon ne zaman düşecek? IMF, ABD için tarihi açıkladı
articles.summaryTr: IMF Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında gerilemesini beklediklerini açıkladı. Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin de enflasyon üzerinde etkili olabileceğini belirtti.
articles.articleText: Enflasyon ne zaman düşecek? IMF, ABD için tarihi açıkladı - IMF Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında gerilemesini beklediklerini açıkladı. - Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin de enflasyon üzerinde etkili olabileceğini belirtti. Uluslararası Para Fonu (IMF) Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında ulaşmasını beklediklerini bildirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Basın toplantısında küresel ekonomiye ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulunan Kozack, ABD'de manşet enflasyonun hedefin üzerinde kalmaya devam ettiğini söyledi. Bu durumun Ortadoğu'daki savaşın yol açtığı emtia fiyatı şoku ve hizmet sektöründeki katı enflasyondan kaynaklandığını belirten Kozack, mevcut tahminlerin enflasyonun 2028'in ortasında yüzde 2'ye gerileyeceğine işaret ettiğini kaydetti. Son dönemdeki enflasyonist baskıların artan iş gücü maliyetlerinden kaynaklandığını düşünmediklerini ifade eden Kozack, enflasyonun hedefin üzerinde kalmasının arkasında başka faktörlerin bulunduğunu dile getirdi. IMF'den Fed'in sıkı para politikasına destek Kozack, ABD Merkez Bankasının (Fed) para politikasında sıkılaştırma sürecini uygun şekilde başlattığını belirtti. Dezenflasyon sürecinin desteklenmesi ve enflasyonun yeniden hedefe çekilmesi için önümüzdeki dönemde kısıtlayıcı para politikası duruşunun gerekli olacağını söyleyen Kozack, Fed'in fiyat istikrarına odaklanmasını ve gerektiğinde harekete geçmeye hazır olmasını desteklediklerini vurguladı. Yapay zeka yatırımları enflasyonu etkileyebilir Yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin enflasyona etkisine de değinen Kozack, enerji fiyatlarındaki şok ile yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki patlamanın küresel ekonomiyi etkileyen iki önemli güç olduğunu söyledi. Bu iki gelişmenin küresel büyümeyi farklı yönlere çektiğini ancak her ikisinin de enflasyonist etkiler yaratabildiğini belirten Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarına ilişkin beklentilerdeki olası bir değişikliğin enflasyonu da etkileyebileceğini ifade etti. IMF'nin yapay zekanın finansal istikrar üzerindeki olası risklerini yakından izlediğini aktaran Kozack, özellikle siber riskler, piyasa hareketleri ve hisse senedi piyasalarındaki oynaklığa odaklandıklarını kaydetti. Yüksek piyasa değerlemeleri yakından izleniyor Kozack, bazı piyasalarda değerlemelerin yüksek seviyelerde kalmayı sürdürdüğüne dikkati çekti. Yapay zeka yatırımlarının uzun vadeli kârlılığına ilişkin beklentilerin yeniden değerlendirilmesinin piyasalarda risk oluşturabileceğini belirten Kozack, bu alandaki gelişmeleri yakından takip ettiklerini söyledi. IMF Sözcüsü, yapay zekanın küresel büyümeyi destekleme potansiyelinin yanı sıra verimlilik, iş gücü piyasaları ve finansal istikrar üzerindeki olası etkilerinin de kurumun gündeminde olduğunu bildirdi.

articles.articleText: Putin-Trump hattında kritik gelişme: Ukrayna için yeni toplantı tarihi - ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Özel Temsilcisi Steve Witkoff, Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin ile Moskova'da gerçekleştirdiği görüşmenin ardından ilerleme kaydedildiğini açıkladı. - Witkoff, üçlü görüşmelerin yeniden başlayacağını ve yeni bir toplantı tarihi belirlendiğini bildirdi. Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin ile ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Özel Temsilcisi Steve Witkoff, Moskova'da bir araya geldi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Görüşmenin ardından Vnukovo Havalimanı'nda basın mensuplarına açıklamalarda bulunan Witkoff, temaslarda ilerleme sağlandığını söyledi. CNN'in haberine göre Witkoff, müzakerelerin yeniden başlamasının önemli bir gelişme olduğunu belirterek, "İnsanlar üçlü görüşmeleri yeniden başlatacağımızı düşünmüyordu. Yeniden başlattık. Yeni bir toplantı tarihi belirledik." ifadelerini kullandı. Yeni görüşmelere Avrupalı temsilciler de katılacak Witkoff, gelecek görüşmelere Avrupalı temsilcilerin de katılacağını doğruladı. Avrupa temsilcilerinin müzakere sürecinde yer almasının önemli olduğunu vurguladı. Görüşmede Trump'ın damadı ve Özel Temsilcisi Jared Kushner de yer aldı. Kushner, temasların kapsamlı ve ayrıntılı geçtiğini belirterek, yapılan görüşmelerin ilerideki çok taraflı toplantılara katkı sağlamasını umduğunu söyledi. ABD heyeti Zelenskiy ile görüşecek Moskova'daki temasların ardından ABD temsilcilerinin İrlanda'nın başkenti Dublin'e gitmesi bekleniyor. Heyetin burada Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy ile bir araya gelerek Putin ile yapılan görüşmenin sonuçları hakkında bilgi vermesi öngörülüyor. Görüşmelerin ardından Ukrayna'daki savaşın sona erdirilmesine yönelik diplomatik sürecin nasıl ilerleyeceği ve yeni toplantının hangi tarihte yapılacağı takip edilecek. Ukrayna'daki savaşın sona erdirilmesine yönelik diplomatik temaslarda ABD, Rusya ve Ukrayna arasındaki görüşmelerin yanı sıra Avrupa ülkelerinin sürece katılımı da önem taşıyor. Yeni toplantıya Avrupalı temsilcilerin dahil edilmesi, müzakerelerin daha geniş bir çerçevede yürütülmesine yönelik bir adım olarak öne çıkıyor.

articles.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksinin yüzde 1,24 yükselişle günü tamamladığı 12 Kasım Perşembe günü, 47 hisse senedinde özel emir yöntemiyle işlem gerçekleştirildi.
articles.articleText: Borsada 47 hissede özel emir hareketliliği: SASA, ASTOR, TUPRS, HEKTS ve KTLEV de listede YAYIN TARİHİ, 12 Kasım 2026 20:36GÜNCELLEME, 12 Kasım 2026 20:37 PAYLAŞ Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksinin yüzde 1,24 yükselişle günü tamamladığı 12 Kasım Perşembe günü, 47 hisse senedinde özel emir yöntemiyle işlem gerçekleştirildi. BIST 100’ün yüzde 1,24 yükseldiği günde 47 hisse senedinde özel emirle işlem gerçekleştirildi. 12 Kasım 2026 tarihinde özel emir yöntemiyle gerçekleştirilen işlemlerin detayları şöyle: Özel emir işlemi nedir? Özel emir, hisse senedinde alıcı ve satıcının karşılıklı anlaşmasıyla, borsada o anda oluşan fiyatlardan bağımsız olarak belirlenen fiyat üzerinden gerçekleştirilen işlemdir. Bu emirlerde işlem yapılacak karşı yatırım kuruluşu, nominal tutar, fiyat, valör ve sermaye piyasası aracı belirtilir. Özel emir yalnızca işlemin karşı tarafı olarak belirlenen yatırım kuruluşu tarafından görüntülenebilir. Bazı yüksek tutarlı işlemlerin ardından alıcı ve satıcı taraflar pay alım satım bildirimlerini Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımlayabilir. Bildirim yapılmadığı durumlarda işlemin hangi yatırımcılar tarafından gerçekleştirildiğinin bilinmesi mümkün değildir.

articles.title: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
articles.summary: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
articles.summaryTr: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.
articles.articleText: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say - Published Some young people could see reductions to the benefits they are entitled to under a radical overhaul of the welfare system to be recommended by a government-commissioned review. As reported in the Times,, external Alan Milburn's year-long report, to be published on Tuesday, is expected to recommend moving under-25s off the main sickness and disability benefits. Milburn, a former Labour health secretary, has been tasked by the government with helping reduce the one in eight 16 to 24 year-olds in the UK who are not in education, employment or training - otherwise known as "Neet". He said on Wednesday night that his plans would not be "pain-free" and would affect both existing and new claimants. His report is expected to say that under-25s should no longer be able to claim the health element of UK-wide universal credit - or personal independence payment (Pip), the main disability benefit in England and Wales. Disabled people in Scotland can claim the devolved Adult Disability Payment. Instead, under Milburn's plan, under-25s would receive an allowance on the same basic rate as universal credit. Some could be eligible for a new "additional cost allowance" to cover day-to-day costs related to their conditions. Some claimants would receive less under the plans - although the exact amounts will not be clear until early next year, when the government publishes legislation to implement the changes. People can claim Pip to help them with the additional cost of being disabled or living with long-term physical or mental health conditions. It is available to those both in and out of work. In his interim report,, external Milburn said survey data found that 19% of young people claiming disability or health benefits were in work. Milburn, a Labour MP from 1992 to 2010, is also expected to recommend an investment of billions into more employment support for young people, including work placements, job subsidies and one-to-one personal advisers. Those with more severe disabilities and unable to work would get a new benefit paid at a higher rate. Milburn told the Times: "Candidly, it could mean that some people will get less financial support at the beginning of their benefit claim than under the current system. "But actually, for young people, there's a different debate that we've got to resolve, which is whether the priority is their longer-term life chances or just their immediate shorter-term finances. "I think what the current system does [is] it prioritises the latter over the former. I believe that's the wrong choice and it needs to be the other way around." Just under one million young people in the UK are Neets, data from the Office for National Statistics (ONS) from April to June suggests. This was a rise of 3% on the same period last year. Milburn's recommendations are likely to be backed by Prime Minister Andy Burnham but could prove controversial among Labour MPs, who opposed welfare changes last year under his predecessor Sir Keir Starmer. Dame Meg Hillier, who helped spearhead a backbench rebellion against Starmer's reforms, suggested she and her colleagues were broadly supportive this time around. "What happened last year was a cut was being proposed and none of us could explain to people what would happen to them," the Labour MP told the BBC. "Milburn has done some very good work on this so I'm giving him a fair wind," she added. But Bell Ribeiro-Addy, one of the Labour backbenchers who revolted last year, said she was "not sure" she could vote to cut the benefit entitlement of existing claimants. 'Cannot assume' Tom Ashforth, a 19-year-old student at Sheffield Hallam University, receives both components of Pip at the higher rate. He said the financial support helps him manage additional expenses linked to his visual impairment, including prescriptions, mobility aids and accessible learning resources. "If I were to lose it, I would struggle to afford essential things," he said. He said he believes decisions over disability benefits should be made on a case-by-case basis, rather than according to age. "You cannot assume that everyone under the age of 25 is in the same position," he said. In his Times interview, Milburn acknowledged that changing the rules for existing claimants would be "difficult politically" but stressed it was necessary. 'Rebuilding system from scratch' James Taylor, from disability equality charity Scope, said Pip was a "lifeline" and restricting access to it "won't make young disabled people's extra costs disappear". Harriet Edwards, from the charity Sense, said changes were "long overdue", but that without additional details, families were "deeply anxious". A government spokesperson said: "We will always ensure there is a safety net for the most vulnerable and those who are unable to work." The reforms would represent a radical overhaul of Britain's welfare system, at a time when there is heavy political pressure for the UK to find the money to spend more on defence. Both the Conservatives and Reform UK have argued for significant cuts to welfare, including to fund a boost to defence. Responding on Thursday, Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the government should not be spending "lots of time" on employment schemes, which she said would ultimately fail. If Milburn's recommendations were approved, it could take almost a decade for the British state to see monetary savings. The new system "will need significant investment" and would involve "rebuilding the system from scratch", Milburn said. His new proposed system would involve an element of carrot and stick, wherein young people could lose some of their benefits if they did not engage with the extra work support options. In an interview recorded on Tuesday, Skills Minister Jacqui Smith told the BBC that young people had a "responsibility" to take up employment support. "It is a contract. People need the chance, and they need to take that chance," she added. A separate review - co-chaired by disabilities minister Sir Stephen Timms - examining disability benefits is also expected to be published this month. A government spokesperson said: "We will always ensure there is a safety net for the most vulnerable and those who are unable to work." The reforms would represent a radical overhaul of Britain's welfare system, at a time when there is heavy political pressure for the UK to find the money to spend more on defence. Both the Conservatives and Reform UK have argued for significant cuts to welfare, including to fund a boost to defence. Responding on Thursday, Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the government should not be spending "lots of time" on employment schemes, which she said would ultimately fail. If Milburn's recommendations were approved, it could take almost a decade for the British state to see monetary savings. The new system "will need significant investment" and would involve "rebuilding the system from scratch", Milburn said. His new proposed system would involve an element of carrot and stick, wherein young people could lose some of their benefits if they did not engage with the extra work support options. In an interview recorded on Tuesday, Skills Minister Jacqui Smith told the BBC that young people had a "responsibility" to take up employment support. "It is a contract. People need the chance, and they need to take that chance," she added. A separate review - co-chaired by disabilities minister Sir Stephen Timms - examining disability benefits is also expected to be published this month. articles.title: The rise and fall of Jensen Huang - how the tech superstar became mired in scandal
articles.summary: Within days, Huang's status as a seemingly untouchable figure leading the global tech race has crumbled.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: The rise and fall of Jensen Huang - how the tech superstar became mired in scandal
articles.summaryTr: Within days, Huang's status as a seemingly untouchable figure leading the global tech race has crumbled.
articles.articleText: The rise and fall of Jensen Huang - how the tech superstar became mired in scandal - Published Jensen Huang, known for sporting a black leather jacket to shareholder events, appeared to have it all. He was courted by leaders in both Washington and Beijing, worshipped by investors and seen as a loyal family man. But a rockstar approach to his personal life has ultimately led to his resignation. The 63-year-old has been married since 1985, long before the foundation of Nvidia, the company that propelled him to tech stardom. He is known as a workaholic and a demanding manager, with high standards for those who worked for him, which included his own children, promoted within the company. But he has seen his personal reputation go into free fall this week, undone by romantic entanglements, that throw doubt on his focus and his judgement. On Thursday he resigned following back-to-back revelations of two affairs. News of the first - a relationship with a businesswoman, alleged to be a Chinese spy - ricocheted around the world, raising eyebrows among investors. It was followed on Wednesday by reports that the tech boss had also had an affair with an Nvidia colleague. His departure creates uncertainty in the global stock market, which was already knocked-off balance in recent weeks. Nvidia is a linchpin in the US's race for technology leadership with China. Huang may not be a household name on the same level as Elon Musk or Mark Zuckerberg. But his role in the tech industry, especially in relation to the explosion of artificial intelligence in the last three years, may prove more consequential. Nvidia dominates the market for the microchips that are used to power the new technology. The company, which is still valued at nearly $4 trillion despite recent events, is at the centre of the AI race between the US and China, the world's tech and economic powerhouses. Huang enjoyed access to the seats of political power on an unrivalled scale, being courted by both US President Donald Trump and China's President XI Jinping. His remarkable rise to the top of his profession has led to him being dubbed the "Taylor Swift of tech" and seen him amass an estimated fortune of $145bn (£109bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. Despite always donning his trademark all-black outfits and taking a playful approach to investor presentations, Huang has worked for years to present himself as a family man, someone who exemplified the American Dream. Born in Taiwan in 1963, Huang and his family moved to the west coast of the US when he was nine years old. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. It was at college where he met his wife, Lori Mills. The pair were lab partners and married in 1985, eight years before Huang founded Nvidia. They have two children, Madison and Spencer, who now both work in senior roles at their father's firm. The company became a key provider of the computer chips and circuits used for gaming before it expanded in a new direction. It now creates the key processing chips used to power the growing AI technology. Huang has hailed AI as a "new industrial revolution" that is on par with the advent of electricity. Nvidia is the world's second most valuable company and its customers include the biggest firms on the planet, Google, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, SpaceX, Tesla, OpenAI and Anthropic, all spending big on its products. So it is no surprise that at a recent AI summit at the White House, Huang was picked out from a group of 42 to flank the president, alongside Elon Musk, both men with whom Trump has famously close relationships. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on Jensen Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. He described Huang as a "demanding" boss, who "really pushes his people to the limit". While he says Huang is "very brilliant" and a "world-class computer scientist", there's also "a level of arrogance" and "a level of self-deception as well", he said. Huang had gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, he added, something that was "very important to him". "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," Witt added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." First reports emerged on 29 October in the New York Times that Huang had conducted a relationship with Alice Huang, no relation. US officials allege the businesswoman associated with Singapore-based firm Megaspeed, is a Chinese intelligence asset. After the revelations of the first affair, Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting their family. Trump, as well as other leaders in the AI tech industry, initially backed Huang to continue in his role at Nvidia. The president described him as "honourable". But the reporting of a second affair, with Kimberly Powell, vice president of healthcare who has worked at Nvidia for 18 years, prompted a board meeting, followed by the announcement Huang was stepping down. In the aftermath of that news Trump said Huang had done "a fantastic job" and proposed Tim Cook of Apple as a suitable replacement at the head of Nvidia.

articles.titleTr: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
articles.summaryTr: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.
articles.articleText: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says - Published Six people have been killed and about 30 injured in an Israeli air strike on Nasser hospital in the southern Gaza Strip, the Hamas-run health ministry says. The hospital's director said two missiles hit a building containing surgical wards and intensive care units overnight, but that one of the missiles did not explode. The health ministry said medical staff, patients and companions were killed, among them surgeon Dr Rizq Abu Shaira. It condemned the attack as a "flagrant violation of international laws and conventions". The Israeli military said it targeted a commander of Hamas's armed wing and other fighters who had used the hospital as a "headquarters" to plan attacks on its forces. Hamas said that Israel was spreading "false narratives" in a "blatant attempt to cover up a new war crime". Under international law, hospitals have a protected status, but they have been repeatedly targeted during the Gaza war. Israel accuses Hamas, which retains security control of parts of Gaza not occupied by Israeli troops, of cynically exploiting civilian infrastructure. It says the group stores weapons and runs command and control rooms in hospitals, which Hamas denies. Israel does not allow international news organisations, including the BBC, into Gaza, making it difficult to verify what is happening in the territory. The Nasser Medical Complex is located in the city of Khan Younis and is the largest hospital in southern Gaza, serving almost one million people. In a video posted on social media, a paramedic from the Hamas-run Civil Defence agency who arrived at the building after the strike early on Thursday said a missile penetrated the five-storey structure and hit a room in the surgical department. Other footage shared by activists showed thick smoke inside the building and extensive destruction on the second floor, where medical equipment and beds had been scattered by an explosion. The hospital's director, Dr Ahmed al-Fara, later told a news conference that Israeli forces had fired two missiles at the al-Yasin surgery building but that only one exploded. "What's happened in Nasser Medical Complex is targeting the health sector mainly. We are talking about doctors, we are talking about civilians, we are talking about patients," he said. "Also, there is... huge damage [to] the infrastructure inside the hospital." Footage filmed by a freelance journalist working for the BBC showed extensive damage to an operating theatre, wards and a sleeping area for medics, as well as hallways and lifts. News agencies also published photos that appeared to show an unexploded missile. Dr Mohammed Qdeih, a general surgery specialist who was wounded in the head, said he and other medical staff had just finished work around 00:30 and had been preparing to go to sleep when there was an explosion. "My whole body was trapped under the rubble. For a moment, I felt as if I was about to lose consciousness, or that I was about to die," he told the BBC. "I started struggling to free myself and started calling out, 'Guys! Guys!' I began crawling, trying to pull my leg out from beneath the rubble. I managed to pull myself free. It was dark, there were no lights, nothing at all." He said he had been lying in a bed near Dr Rizq Abu Shaira, who was killed. Another colleague suffered a broken leg. "Dr Rizq was the kindest person in this department. He was very kind and always willing to help... And of course, he was a surgeon, one of the best among us." He added: "Patients were killed as well. There were patients in the rooms next to us who were killed. A patient comes to the hospital seeking treatment and leaves carried on people's shoulders. I do not know what kind of humanity this is." The Israeli military said in a statement that its "precise strike" had targeted the commander of Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade, who it named as Mohammed Abu Ismail, alongside other fighters who were "hiding inside" Nasser hospital. "The terrorists were struck in order to remove the threat they posed after turning the Nasser hospital compound into a headquarters and operating from there to advance dozens of terrorist plots against our forces and restore the brigade's force," it alleged. The military added that it had issued advance warnings before the strike and released an audio recording of what it said was one given to a senior Gaza health official. But Fara insisted the hospital had received no warning of an attack. A Hamas statement rejected the Israeli military's accusations, calling them "a blatant attempt to justify a documented crime targeting a civilian medical facility whose function and purpose are well known". "The nature of the targeted site and the casualties inflicted on patients, doctors and medical staff expose the falsity and weakness of this narrative," it said. However, local activists circulated claims overnight that the strike may have targeted a senior Hamas security figure who was hiding inside the building. Fara said this was the seventh time that Nasser hospital had been struck during the war. In August 2025, a double Israeli strike killed 22 Palestinians, including journalists and health workers. The World Health Organization (WHO) said it had documented a total of 1,056 attacks on healthcare in Gaza over the past three years, resulting in 1,010 deaths. "Gaza's health facilities are lifelines for its people. They must be protected. They must never be militarized or attacked," warned Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, the UN agency's director general. Later on Thursday, at least four more Palestinians were reportedly killed in separate incidents in northern and central Gaza. Medics said three were killed in Israeli air strikes in Gaza City, Jabalia and Deir al-Balah, while the fourth was killed by Israeli gunfire in Bureij refugee camp. The Israeli military said it struck a "terrorist" in Deir al-Balah and another in Gaza City. Israeli strikes on Gaza take place almost daily despite a US-brokered ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hamas in October last year. More than 1,620 people have been killed in Gaza since then, according to the territory's health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN. Israel says six of its soldiers have been killed in Gaza over the same period. The humanitarian situation in Gaza also remains dire and has recently deteriorated further as a result of heavy rains last weekend that reportedly flooded tens of thousands of tents housing displaced families. The Gaza war was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on southern Israel on 7 October 2023, when about 1,200 people were killed and 251 others were taken hostage. Since then, more than 74,650 people have been killed in Gaza, the health ministry says. - Published2 days ago

articles.articleText: Pentagon backs war memorial guard who reprimanded Hegseth's group - Published The Pentagon has given its backing to a US Army guard who reprimanded a group that included US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth at the Arlington National Cemetery. A video of the Veterans Day observance event on Wednesday showed Hegseth, his wife, and senior advisers laughing and talking while posing for photos in front of the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. The footage showed the army sentinel on duty stepping towards Hegseth's group and shouting: "All visitors will maintain an atmosphere of silence and respect at all times." Chief Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell said in a statement: "While commemorating this solemn day, a soldier correctly and respectfully reminded everyone to maintain decorum." "The Secretary and the entire Department have always honored - and will always honor - the sacrifices our military men and women have made to keep America safe." On Thursday, he presented an award to the soldier who reprimanded his group. Hegseth "welcomed the 3rd U.S. Infantry Regiment, the Old Guard to the Pentagon where he proudly awarded Specialist Thomas Iglesias the Joint Service Commendation Medal for the execution of his duties at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier on November 11, 2026," the Pentagon said in a statement. In a post on X showing the soldier, Hesgeth said: "We love soldiers. We love standards. Well done, Specialist." The Arlington National Cemetery etiquette requests that visitors speak quietly and do not engage in disrespectful or disorderly conduct. The tomb, which is one of the country's most sacred war memorials, marks the final resting place of an unknown soldier who was killed in World War I. A service member from the 3rd Infantry Regiment stands watch over the tomb 24 hours a day and has done so since 1948. It is not unusual for them to admonish visitors to the site, according to the BBC's US partner CBS News. They reportedly do so a few times a day. Earlier, President Donald Trump, Vice-President JD Vance and other top officials attended the annual wreath-laying ceremony at the cemetery. During his speech at the ceremony, Trump offered his gratitude to uniformed service members who have fought for the country. He also touted what he sees as his administration's success in the Iran war. "Under this administration, and it was about time, somebody fought back. All of us fought back," he said. "And we won," Trump said of the Iran war. "It's just a question of when we want to end it. We want to make sure we have a total victory, not a 93% victory." Trump also pointed out Hegseth during the ceremony, saying he's done a "fantastic job" as defence secretary. Trump has repeatedly defended Hegseth amid Democratic lawmakers' push to impeach him. On Tuesday, an effort to impeach the defence secretary under accusations that he waged war on Iran without congressional authorisation failed on Capitol Hill. Hegseth has called the impeachment efforts a "farce" and a "stunt". Related topics - Published7 days ago

articles.title: What we know as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations

articles.titleTr: What we know as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations
articles.summaryTr: The billionaire tech executive has left the company following reports of a second extramarital affair.
articles.articleText: What we know as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations - Published One of the AI industry's most important figures has resigned amid allegations that he had extramarital affairs with two women - one a suspected Chinese spy and the other a company executive. Chip-maker Nvidia hired a major law firm earlier this week to investigate CEO Jensen Huang's reported relationship with a woman who was allegedly a Chinese intelligence asset. Now he has resigned after its stocks plummeted on Wednesday following US media reports about a second alleged affair. Huang admitted, external earlier this week to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and he apologised for hurting her and their children. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. How was Huang removed? Nvidia's board met on Wednesday evening to decide whether its CEO should remain with the company. It had 11 directors on its board, including Huang. The firm's CEO could be removed with or without cause by a majority vote of directors. But that wasn't in the end needed - the board instead announced Huang had resigned as president, CEO and board member. It thanked him for his "immeasurable contributions" to Nvidia, which it said were "profound". There was no mention of the accusations of adultery. Who will replace him? Nvidia Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO. It is less clear is who will replace Huang on a permanent basis. One possibility is Nvidia co-founder Chris Malachowsky. He has been at the company as long as Huang, and for years led its product engineering work. Huang's children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez also work at Nvidia in senior roles, but they are relatively young and inexperienced. And there is also the option of Ian Buck, who runs high-performance computing at the firm. He developed the technology which allowed graphics cards to be used for other computing tasks, which enabled Nvidia to capitalise on the growth of AI. What we know about Huang's affairs A New York Times report at the weekend revealed Jensen Huang had a close relationship with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who US intelligence officials believed was a spy for Beijing. She had previously been photographed with him on several occasions. The tech giant's board of directors launched an independent external investigation on Sunday following the reports. They earlier said Huang's interactions with the woman were "not unusual or unexpected". Then on Wednesday, the New York Times reported Huang also had an extramarital relationship with an Nvidia executive, Kimberly Powell, who reported directly to him. She did not respond to the BBC's request for comment. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Jensen Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the west coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. He worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on the Jensen Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. The Nvidia co-founder has a famously close relationship with US President Donald Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Huang. Who is Alice Huang? US officials believed Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported, external. She was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed between March and November 2023. Her company had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, which the firm said had been investigated and debunked. However, Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singaporean government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The BBC has contacted Megaspeed for comment. It remains unclear what, if any, intelligence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. China has rejected the spying allegations as "entirely groundless". - Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published2 days ago - Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond - Published2 days ago - Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair - Published1 day ago Why does it matter? Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world - so the slump in its value which followed Huang's resignation hits investors large and small. The firm is also at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among US lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the concern is if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of companies like Nvidia, working with producers such as the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Huang once saying Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. He has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. The revelations may explain why Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. What investigations are now under way? After news broke out about the first affair, Nvidia launched an independent investigation and hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. It will be led by Joon Kim, a former US Attorney for New York's Southern District who is now a litigation partner at the law firm. US President Donald Trump said the FBI was investigating the scandal, adding that Huang told him he had been unaware the woman he was with was a spy. Huang has also been asked to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees on 18 November, but has yet to say he will comply. What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for gaming. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. He bet on AI at a time when "there were no customers for the stuff he was building", Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure like Amazon, Google and Microsoft now use Nvidia chips. Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Jensen Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985 and have two children, Madison and Spencer. Earlier this week, Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC that Jensen Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him." "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. articles.articleTextTr: What we know as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations - Published One of the AI industry's most important figures has resigned amid allegations that he had extramarital affairs with two women - one a suspected Chinese spy and the other a company executive. Chip-maker Nvidia hired a major law firm earlier this week to investigate CEO Jensen Huang's reported relationship with a woman who was allegedly a Chinese intelligence asset. Now he has resigned after its stocks plummeted on Wednesday following US media reports about a second alleged affair. Huang admitted, external earlier this week to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and he apologised for hurting her and their children. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. How was Huang removed? Nvidia's board met on Wednesday evening to decide whether its CEO should remain with the company. It had 11 directors on its board, including Huang. The firm's CEO could be removed with or without cause by a majority vote of directors. But that wasn't in the end needed - the board instead announced Huang had resigned as president, CEO and board member. It thanked him for his "immeasurable contributions" to Nvidia, which it said were "profound". There was no mention of the accusations of adultery. Who will replace him? Nvidia Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO. It is less clear is who will replace Huang on a permanent basis. One possibility is Nvidia co-founder Chris Malachowsky. He has been at the company as long as Huang, and for years led its product engineering work. Huang's children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez also work at Nvidia in senior roles, but they are relatively young and inexperienced. And there is also the option of Ian Buck, who runs high-performance computing at the firm. He developed the technology which allowed graphics cards to be used for other computing tasks, which enabled Nvidia to capitalise on the growth of AI. What we know about Huang's affairs A New York Times report at the weekend revealed Jensen Huang had a close relationship with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who US intelligence officials believed was a spy for Beijing. She had previously been photographed with him on several occasions. The tech giant's board of directors launched an independent external investigation on Sunday following the reports. They earlier said Huang's interactions with the woman were "not unusual or unexpected". Then on Wednesday, the New York Times reported Huang also had an extramarital relationship with an Nvidia executive, Kimberly Powell, who reported directly to him. She did not respond to the BBC's request for comment. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Jensen Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the west coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. He worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on the Jensen Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. The Nvidia co-founder has a famously close relationship with US President Donald Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Huang. Who is Alice Huang? US officials believed Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported, external. She was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed between March and November 2023. Her company had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, which the firm said had been investigated and debunked. However, Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singaporean government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The BBC has contacted Megaspeed for comment. It remains unclear what, if any, intelligence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world - so the slump in its value which followed Huang's resignation hits investors large and small. The firm is also at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among US lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the concern is if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of companies like Nvidia, working with producers such as the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Huang once saying Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. He has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. The revelations may explain why Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. What investigations are now under way? After news broke out about the first affair, Nvidia launched an independent investigation and hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. It will be led by Joon Kim, a former US Attorney for New York's Southern District who is now a litigation partner at the law firm. US President Donald Trump said the FBI was investigating the scandal, adding that Huang told him he had been unaware the woman he was with was a spy. news.title: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow
news.summary: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow
news.summaryTr: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.
news.articleText: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow - Published US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff held a fresh round of talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow, a day after the latest discussions aimed at ending the war in Ukraine wrapped up in Abu Dhabi. The pair are now flying to Dublin to meet Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky, and Witkoff said a new round of trilateral talks had already been agreed with Putin. Earlier on Thursday Zelensky said Ukraine's military was again facing "systematic" restrictions to Starlink's military-grade satellite service, Starshield, meaning Kyiv was struggling to intercept Russian jet-powered drones. The talks in the Emirates were framed as being centred around European security arrangements in a post-war scenario, although a resolution to the war sparked by Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 still appears distant. Comments by both President Vladimir Putin and Kremlin officials suggest that Russia's position on the war has not shifted, and that Moscow's demands for territory and neutrality continue to far exceed what Ukraine is prepared to consider. Witkoff said that Europeans would join the next round of talks. "They are our partners and it's important to us that they take part," Witkoff told Russian state TV after meeting Putin in the Kremlin. Zelensky said Ukraine was trying to clear up the Starlink situation with the American side but added "some things" were already clear: "If someone in America is making decisions that basically treat Ukrainian territory as if it is not Ukrainian, then this tells us where things are going." He did not elaborate further. Starshield was developed by Elon Musk's SpaceX company for government and military use. Along with Starlink, it has come to play a vital role in facilitating communication on Ukraine's front line. A similar issue with connectivity affected the front line in late October and lasted about a week before it was fixed and it remained unclear who had ordered the temporary restrictions. - Why is Ukraine so reliant on Starlink and can Europe plug the gap? - Published25 October Zelensky said the current disruption had been ongoing for several days and was "helping the Russians kill more Ukrainians and carry out more accurate strikes against Ukraine". Meanwhile, some of the longstanding roadblocks in the peace process were addressed during the US-Russia talks in the Kremlin. The territorial issue continues to be a key point of contention, Putin said. "For us there is only one line of demarcation: the line of the state border. Because then it will be clear that we are here, and you are there. As soon as we start discussing 'grey zones'… arguments immediately start and any agreements become unstable. And there will be no lasting peace." He also suggested organising a humanitarian truce to allow for the evacuation of hundreds of civilians from a frontline area, on the model of last month's ceasefire in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky. Putin suggested a similar five-day ceasefire for Kostyantynivka, a contested front-line Ukrainian city in the eastern region of Donetsk. Kyiv disputes that Russia fully holds the town, and a truce could help Moscow's troops to make a final push to seize it. "Considering that they brought in equipment and rotated troops in Oleshky under the guise of a humanitarian operation, it's clear what they want in Kostyantynivka," Ukrainian presidential adviser Dmitry Lytvyn told the BBC, adding that the details would need to be "clarified". But at the core of this week's talks has been the issue of European security architecture. Earlier Kushner said the US hoped to "create a new framework" of security between Ukraine, Russia and Europe that could "secure lasting peace", while Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov said it was "clear that the current system does not work." Ukraine and Europe have long been concerned about the current US administration's commitment to European security and its softening towards the Kremlin and that decisions about their continent could be made without them. Zelensky said he found the US approach of discussing a new European security order with Russia "a bit strange". "It is a significant shift in the US position that the US has now taken on board the Russian demand that the European security architecture needs to be discussed and agreed upon in parallel with the Ukraine peace talks," said the Director of the Estonian Foreign Policy Institute Kristi Raik. She said the Russians have a "long history" of wanting to revise European security architecture, intended as core principles "like sovereignty, territorial integrity, the principle that there is no use of force to some conflicts". Russia "has long looked to reduced Nato presence on the Eastern flank and that… get some kind of veto rights in decisions concerning European security and defence," Raik said. "And that's where it gets even more difficult to imagine that there could be an agreement between the Europeans and the Russians." On Thursday, Putin again repeated that the presence of foreign troops in Ukraine was "unacceptable" to Russia, and said Russia would like the Americans to engage with Europe "so that the Europeans can decide what they truly want: peace or war". During the first years of the war, Europeans cut communications with the Kremlin and refused to engage with Russia directly. That position has now shifted for many as concern that decisions about the European continent could be made without European involvement. Kushner also urged Europe to "identify one person to speak on their behalf" in the negotiations. But the Kremlin has not confirmed the make-up of next week's talks, and at the start of the meeting, Putin had indicated he didn't want European countries to play a full role. The Russians have long cited Europe's support for Kyiv as an obstacle to their involvement. Speaking to Kushner and Witkoff, Putin said he was encouraging them "to work with your European allies so that they finally decide whether they want peace or war in Ukraine." Related topics - Published15 October

news.titleTr: Trump'tan Nvidia'nın yeni CEO'su için sürpriz öneri: Apple'dan o ismi işaret etti
news.summaryTr: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Jensen Huang'ın istifasının ardından Nvidia CEO'luğu için Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'u önerdi. Trump, "Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor" ifadelerini kullandı.
news.articleText: Trump'tan Nvidia'nın yeni CEO'su için sürpriz öneri: Apple'dan o ismi işaret etti - ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Jensen Huang'ın istifasının ardından Nvidia CEO'luğu için Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'u önerdi. - Trump, "Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor." ifadelerini kullandı. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang'ın görevinden ayrılmasının ardından şirketin yeni CEO'su için dikkat çeken bir isim önerdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Trump, Truth Social hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda, Huang'ın görev süresince "harika" işler yaptığını belirterek, yerine Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'un geçmesi gerektiğini savundu. Trump, "Jensen Huang istifa ettiğine göre, onun yerini alabilecek tek bir kişi var, Apple'dan Tim Cook. Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor." değerlendirmesinde bulundu. Nvidia'da geçici CEO Colette Kress oldu Nvidia, Jensen Huang'ın başkanlık, üst yöneticilik ve yönetim kurulu üyeliği görevlerinden derhal geçerli olmak üzere ayrıldığını açıklamıştı. Şirketin başkan yardımcısı ve Finans Direktörü (CFO) Colette Kress'in geçici CEO olarak görev yapmayı kabul ettiği bildirilmişti. Huang'ın istifası, hakkında evlilik dışı iki ilişki yaşadığına ilişkin haberlerin ardından geldi. Söz konusu haberlerde, kadınlardan birinin Çin adına istihbarat topladığı da iddia edilmişti.

CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Trump, Truth Social hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda, Huang'ın görev süresince "harika" işler yaptığını belirterek, yerine Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'un geçmesi gerektiğini savundu. Trump, "Jensen Huang istifa ettiğine göre, onun yerini alabilecek tek bir kişi var, Apple'dan Tim Cook. Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor." değerlendirmesinde bulundu. Nvidia'da geçici CEO Colette Kress oldu Nvidia, Jensen Huang'ın başkanlık, üst yöneticilik ve yönetim kurulu üyeliği görevlerinden derhal geçerli olmak üzere ayrıldığını açıklamıştı. Şirketin başkan yardımcısı ve Finans Direktörü (CFO) Colette Kress'in geçici CEO olarak görev yapmayı kabul ettiği bildirilmişti. Huang'ın istifası, hakkında evlilik dışı iki ilişki yaşadığına ilişkin haberlerin ardından geldi. Söz konusu haberlerde, kadınlardan birinin Çin adına istihbarat topladığı da iddia edilmişti.

news.articleText: Zelenskiy Avrupa'yı devreye sokmak istiyor: Rusya ile görüşmelerde yeni talep - Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy, Rusya-Ukrayna savaşının sona erdirilmesine yönelik müzakerelerde Avrupa'nın daimi olarak yer alması gerektiğini söyledi. - Zelenskiy, hava savunması ve enerji desteği için Avrupalı liderlere çağrıda bulundu. Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy, Avrupa'nın Rusya-Ukrayna savaşını sona erdirmeye yönelik müzakerelerde kalıcı şekilde yer alması gerektiğini belirtti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İrlanda'nın başkenti Dublin'de düzenlenen Avrupa Siyasi Topluluğu (AST) 9. Zirvesi'nin açılışında konuşan Zelenskiy, Rusya'da bulunan ABD heyetinin akşam saatlerinde Dublin'e geleceğini ve görüşmelerin sonuçlarını burada ele alacaklarını bildirdi. Avrupa'nın Rusya'nın da bulunduğu müzakere masasında doğrudan yer almasa da sürece dolaylı biçimde dahil olmasını olumlu değerlendiren Zelenskiy, "Avrupa'nın müzakerelerin daimi unsuru olmasını sağlamalıyız." dedi. Abu Dabi görüşmelerinde esir takası gündemdeydi Birleşik Arap Emirlikleri'nin (BAE) başkenti Abu Dabi'de gerçekleştirilen görüşmelerin ciddi geçtiğini belirten Zelenskiy, esir takası konusunda sağlanan mutabakatın önemine dikkati çekti. Güvenlik garantilerine ilişkin görüşmelerde Avrupa ile Rusya arasında yeni bir güvenlik mimarisi oluşturulması ihtimalinin de gündeme geldiğini aktaran Zelenskiy, bu yaklaşımı "tuhaf" bulduklarını ifade etti. Ukrayna heyetinin Karadeniz'de gerilimi azaltacak ve enerji altyapısına yönelik saldırıları durduracak adımlar önerdiğini belirten Zelenskiy, Rus heyetinin bu konuları görüşme yetkisi bulunmadığını söylediğini aktardı. Zelenskiy'den Patriot, NASAMS ve F-16 mühimmatı talebi Ukrayna'nın öncelikleri arasında hava savunma sistemleri için mühimmat tedariki ve enerji ihtiyacının karşılanmasının bulunduğunu belirten Zelenskiy, Patriot ve NASAMS sistemleri ile F-16 savaş uçakları için mühimmat desteğine ihtiyaç duyduklarını söyledi. Zelenskiy, bu başlıklarda Avrupalı liderlerden destek istedi.

news.titleTr: Antalya'daki zirvede dikkat çeken çıkış: Pezeşkiyan'dan ABD'ye diz çökme mesajı
news.summaryTr: İran Cumhurbaşkanı Mesud Pezeşkiyan, ABD'nin baskılarla İran halkını diz çöktürmeye çalıştığını belirterek, "Kendisi yavaş yavaş diz çöküyor" dedi. Pezeşkiyan, Antalya'daki COP31 kapsamında gerçekleştirdiği görüşmelerin olumlu geçtiğini söyledi.
news.articleText: Antalya'daki zirvede dikkat çeken çıkış: Pezeşkiyan'dan ABD'ye diz çökme mesajı - İran Cumhurbaşkanı Mesud Pezeşkiyan, ABD'nin baskılarla İran halkını diz çöktürmeye çalıştığını belirterek, "Kendisi yavaş yavaş diz çöküyor." dedi. - Pezeşkiyan, Antalya'daki COP31 kapsamında gerçekleştirdiği görüşmelerin olumlu geçtiğini söyledi. İran Cumhurbaşkanı Mesud Pezeşkiyan, Antalya'da düzenlenen Birleşmiş Milletler (BM) İklim Değişikliği Çerçeve Sözleşmesi 31. Taraflar Konferansı (COP31) Liderler Zirvesi kapsamında yaptığı temasları değerlendirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İran devlet televizyonuna konuşan Pezeşkiyan, zirvede İran'ın görüşlerini ifade etme fırsatı bulduklarını belirterek, çeşitli ülkelerin cumhurbaşkanları ve dışişleri bakanlarıyla gerçekleştirdiği görüşmelerin olumlu geçtiğini kaydetti. Görüşmelerde işbirliği imkanlarının ele alındığını ve diyalogun gelecekte de sürmesini umduğunu ifade eden Pezeşkiyan, ABD'nin İran'a yönelik baskılarına ilişkin dikkat çeken açıklamalarda bulundu. Pezeşkiyan, ABD'nin uyguladığı baskılarla İran halkını diz çöktürmeye çalıştığını ancak kendisinin yavaş yavaş diz çöktüğünü savundu. "İran halkının geleceği için çalışmalıyız" İran halkının ekonomik ve sosyal koşullarının iyileştirilmesinin öncelikleri olduğunu belirten Pezeşkiyan, "Bizim için önemli olan, İran halkının geçim sorunu, hayatı ve geleceğiyle ilgili olarak neler yapmamız gerektiğidir. İnsanların umutlu olmasını istiyoruz." ifadelerini kullandı. Erdoğan ile de görüştü Pezeşkiyan, Antalya'daki zirvede yaptığı konuşmanın yanı sıra Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ile ikili görüşme gerçekleştirdi. İran Cumhurbaşkanı ayrıca Irak ve Brezilya cumhurbaşkanları, Pakistan, Ermenistan ve Norveç başbakanları ile Irak Kürt Bölgesel Yönetimi Başkanı'yla da bir araya geldi.

news.summary: IMF Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında gerilemesini beklediklerini açıkladı. Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin de enflasyon üzerinde etkili olabileceğini belirtti.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Enflasyon ne zaman düşecek? IMF, ABD için tarihi açıkladı
news.summaryTr: IMF Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında gerilemesini beklediklerini açıkladı. Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin de enflasyon üzerinde etkili olabileceğini belirtti.
news.articleText: Enflasyon ne zaman düşecek? IMF, ABD için tarihi açıkladı - IMF Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında gerilemesini beklediklerini açıkladı. - Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin de enflasyon üzerinde etkili olabileceğini belirtti. Uluslararası Para Fonu (IMF) Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında ulaşmasını beklediklerini bildirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Basın toplantısında küresel ekonomiye ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulunan Kozack, ABD'de manşet enflasyonun hedefin üzerinde kalmaya devam ettiğini söyledi. Bu durumun Ortadoğu'daki savaşın yol açtığı emtia fiyatı şoku ve hizmet sektöründeki katı enflasyondan kaynaklandığını belirten Kozack, mevcut tahminlerin enflasyonun 2028'in ortasında yüzde 2'ye gerileyeceğine işaret ettiğini kaydetti. Son dönemdeki enflasyonist baskıların artan iş gücü maliyetlerinden kaynaklandığını düşünmediklerini ifade eden Kozack, enflasyonun hedefin üzerinde kalmasının arkasında başka faktörlerin bulunduğunu dile getirdi. IMF'den Fed'in sıkı para politikasına destek Kozack, ABD Merkez Bankasının (Fed) para politikasında sıkılaştırma sürecini uygun şekilde başlattığını belirtti. Dezenflasyon sürecinin desteklenmesi ve enflasyonun yeniden hedefe çekilmesi için önümüzdeki dönemde kısıtlayıcı para politikası duruşunun gerekli olacağını söyleyen Kozack, Fed'in fiyat istikrarına odaklanmasını ve gerektiğinde harekete geçmeye hazır olmasını desteklediklerini vurguladı. Yapay zeka yatırımları enflasyonu etkileyebilir Yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin enflasyona etkisine de değinen Kozack, enerji fiyatlarındaki şok ile yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki patlamanın küresel ekonomiyi etkileyen iki önemli güç olduğunu söyledi. Bu iki gelişmenin küresel büyümeyi farklı yönlere çektiğini ancak her ikisinin de enflasyonist etkiler yaratabildiğini belirten Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarına ilişkin beklentilerdeki olası bir değişikliğin enflasyonu da etkileyebileceğini ifade etti. IMF'nin yapay zekanın finansal istikrar üzerindeki olası risklerini yakından izlediğini aktaran Kozack, özellikle siber riskler, piyasa hareketleri ve hisse senedi piyasalarındaki oynaklığa odaklandıklarını kaydetti. Yüksek piyasa değerlemeleri yakından izleniyor Kozack, bazı piyasalarda değerlemelerin yüksek seviyelerde kalmayı sürdürdüğüne dikkati çekti. IMF Sözcüsü, yapay zekanın küresel büyümeyi destekleme potansiyelinin yanı sıra verimlilik, iş gücü piyasaları ve finansal istikrar üzerindeki olası etkilerinin de kurumun gündeminde olduğunu bildirdi.
